title: True Rewards for Travelers Compatibility
description: Compatability for Traveler Rewards with Waystones, Tough as Nails and more...
body:
Compatibility layer so the rewards from my main mod function well with other popular mods, particularly Waystones but also temperature and gravestone mods.

Compat Supported with:

Waystones: 
Only items in soulbound slots will travel with the player when they teleport, unless Traveler's blessing is in effect

Tough as Nails:
Added two "Blessings" (potion effects) which can be found in Ancient structures and either protect the player from hot or cold effects


These blessings (potion effects) offer early game protection from climate effects so the player can explore freely,
and can be found in places like desert and jungle pyramids, shipwrecks and pillager forts.
